A Recent Wilmslow Garden Project

We recently completed a challenging rear garden transformation on Knutsford Road, Wilmslow — a sloping plot with significant level changes that had defeated a previous landscaper. Our solution was a two-tier garden design: a new retaining wall in natural sandstone created a level upper terrace, while the lower garden was turfed with premium lawn turf and bordered with a curved planting scheme of evergreen shrubs and perennials. A wide run of porcelain steps connected the two levels, and LED bollard lighting was set into the retaining wall to create a stunning effect after dark. This project is a perfect example of the kind of solution-focused landscaping that has made us one of the most recommended landscape gardeners in Wilmslow.

Gardening in Wilmslow: Local Knowledge Matters

Wilmslow's residential areas range from Edwardian and Victorian semi-detached properties in Dean Row and Handforth to large modern detached homes in the prestigious roads off Alderley Road and Macclesfield Road. Each property type brings its own challenges and opportunities. The older properties often have established boundary trees and deep clay borders that require careful preparation before new planting. New-build gardens in Wilmslow frequently suffer from compacted subsoil left by builders — a problem our landscape gardener Wilmslow team corrects with soil remediation before any new turf or planting goes in. We also understand the value of privacy screening in this densely populated suburb, and we design bespoke planting schemes and fencing solutions that create seclusion without feeling enclosed.

What Wilmslow Clients Say

"The team transformed what was a very difficult sloping garden into something genuinely beautiful. They handled every detail — drainage, levels, planting — and the communication throughout was excellent. We've already recommended them to our neighbours." — Mark & Louise B, Wilmslow

Areas We Cover Around Wilmslow

Our landscape gardener Wilmslow service covers the full postcode area including Handforth, Dean Row, Alderley Edge, Styal, Morley Green, and Mobberley. We regularly work within easy reach of Wilmslow town centre and the surrounding villages, and our knowledge of local planning considerations — including work in proximity to the Bollin Valley — means your project is handled with full awareness of any relevant constraints.
